high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "mapster_17," located in Athens, Greece. The post is titled "EUROPE ACCORDING TO GREECE" and has garnered 32,758 likes since it was posted on July 10. The main content of the post is a humorous map of Europe, where each country is labeled with a stereotype or cultural reference originating from Greek perspectives. Here's a breakdown of some of the labels: United Kingdom: "Gingers and Beer" Ireland: "George Michael" France: "Friends"
